chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: A short stay with Fats Waller
summary: Theatre dates with Fats in Washington, Baltimore and Philadelphia before Louis Armstrong approaches him.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: (Side B of Tape 3 begins at this point.)
So you probably would have joined Fats around Memorial Day, I would guess; somewhere around there. The spring or summer.
Yes. Yeah, but I didn't stay with Fats very long.
You say you didn't stay with Fats long; Fats was playing theatres mostly?
Right. I played a lot of theatres.with him.
How far did you go out with him?
My first engagement with him was at the Howard Theatre in Washington; then we went to the Royal Theatre in Baltimore. In Philadelphia we played right across from the Douglas Hotel.
So basically you did only these theatres with him?
No, I played one nighters with him, but I wasn't with him too long, until Louis approached me. I joined Louis in '35.
